text: This is the best clinic I've been to. I've tried many clinics, and I'm very satisfied. The staff are lovely and polite, the assistants are good, and the doctor is excellent. The doctor is very gentle. Overall, it's excellent. I didn't feel any pain at all when I had my tooth extracted.

I went for a teeth cleaning (tartar removal). The dentist provided excellent service. The price was reasonable for the quality. The clinic was clean. I'll be bringing my parents along soon. I'm very impressed.

I went to get a tooth extracted. The dentist was very nice, and the staff were lovely too. The anesthetic was very gentle. I was extremely impressed. I'll be bringing my husband along for a teeth cleaning soon.

Hey, at first I was terrified of local anesthetic injections!
But every time I come to Dr. Kob's clinic, the pain, the stinging, and soreness that other people describe never happens to me. When I had my wisdom tooth extracted, I barely noticed the injection. And when I had root canal treatment, they applied a topical anesthetic before the actual injection, so it was completely painless! The only thing I experienced was a sore mouth.
Finally, everyone should get their teeth cleaned (tartar removed) twice a year; it's the best!
The doctor was very kind and explained everything thoroughly. The treatment cost was not expensive. I was very impressed.

They removed my wisdom tooth, took x-rays, examined everything, and explained the cause of the pain (they were tolerant of my poor English skills; they explained everything through Google Translate). The procedure itself took about 10 minutes. The doctor is very knowledgeable. I'm very grateful to the staff at this clinic.

My retainer broke, and the clinic was accommodating and found an appointment for the very next day, as the broken retainer was scratching my tongue. The doctor immediately understood the problem and what I wanted. Everything was done quickly and seemed to go well.

The people were pleasant to talk to.

I highly recommend them!

A small Thai clinic. I've been getting my teeth treated here for two years. I've had fillings, whitening, a crown, and a wisdom tooth extraction. The staff is friendly and the clinic is clean. They speak English.

I had my wisdom tooth removed. They took photos and gave me recommendations for other teeth. Everything went so quickly I didn't even understand a word. They work very quickly and efficiently! The clinic is clean, and the staff speaks fluent English! My appointment was in two hours, and I really liked how uncrowded it was!
